questions.question: What does SOM stand for in market analysis?
questions.questionHtml: What does SOM stand for in market analysis?
questions.feedback: SOM stands for Share of Market — the realistic portion of your target market you can capture. It is the most focused of the three tiers (TAM > SAM > SOM).
questions.feedbackHtml: SOM stands for Share of Market — the realistic portion of your target market you can capture.

answers.text: The brand and model of your drone equipment

answers.text: The results and deliverables you provide to clients
answers.textHtml: The results and deliverables you provide to clients

answers.textHtml: The number of years you have been flying

questions.feedback: Clients care about results, not your equipment. Focus your competitive positioning on the quality of deliverables and outcomes you provide.

questions.question: Select ALL that apply: What are examples of indirect competition for a drone business?
questions.questionHtml: Select ALL that apply: What are examples of indirect competition for a drone business?
questions.feedback: Indirect competitors provide alternative solutions to the same problem. Satellites, ground crews, and helicopters are all indirect competitors. Other drone operators are direct competitors.
questions.feedbackHtml: Indirect competitors provide alternative solutions to the same problem using different methods.

questions.question: How should you handle unlicensed drone operators competing in your market?
questions.questionHtml: How should you handle unlicensed drone operators competing in your market?

answers.text: Report every unlicensed operator to the FAA
answers.textHtml: Report every unlicensed operator to the FAA

answers.text: Lower your prices to match theirs
Educate your clients about the risks of hiring unlicensed operators
answers.textHtml: Educate your clients about the risks of hiring unlicensed operators

questions.feedback: Focus on educating your clients about the liability and safety risks of hiring unlicensed operators, rather than wasting time policing competitors. Report only genuinely dangerous behavior.
questions.feedbackHtml: Focus on educating clients about the risks rather than policing competitors. Report only dangerous behavior.
